name: Ray Marching with Single Scattering
aliases: Volumetric Cloud Rendering with Ray Marching
definition: A real-time volumetric rendering technique using OpenGL ray marching, procedural noise for density, and physically-based single scattering illumination to render volumetric clouds.
summary: Ray Marching with Single Scattering is a real-time volumetric rendering technique that approximates light transport with a single scattering event per sample to efficiently render translucent, animated clouds.
